systems.system: DHIS2 platform of the Ministry of the Interior for statistical data collection, from the communes up to central level
systems.owner: Ministry of the Interior, Community Development and Public Security; partners named are UNICEF, UNFPA and UNDP
systems.tiers: under development as at 12 March 2026; pilot planned for May 2026 in some regions before national extension; to collect from communes to the centre; over a thousand users to be trained

note: A system in development that communes are to report in, with no office yet working in it; workshop participants named the availability of an internet connection in some areas as a concern, and the document states no connection of commune offices.
